import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import json
import sys

df = pd.read_csv(sys.argv[1])

facts = []

def add(entity, metric, period, value, formula):
    if pd.isna(value):
        return
    facts.append({
        "entity": entity,
        "metric": metric,
        "period": period,
        "value": float(round(value, 2)),
        "formula": formula
    })

# TOTALS
tot_rev_tw = df["Revenue_TW"].sum(skipna=True)
tot_rev_lw = df["Revenue_LW"].sum(skipna=True)
tot_rev_ly = df["Revenue_LY"].sum(skipna=True)
tot_units_tw = df["Units_TW"].sum(skipna=True)
tot_units_lw = df["Units_LW"].sum(skipna=True)
tot_orders_tw = df["Orders_TW"].sum(skipna=True)
tot_orders_lw = df["Orders_LW"].sum(skipna=True)

add("TOTAL", "revenue", "TW", tot_rev_tw, "sum(Revenue_TW)")
add("TOTAL", "revenue", "LW", tot_rev_lw, "sum(Revenue_LW)")
add("TOTAL", "revenue", "LY", tot_rev_ly, "sum(Revenue_LY)")
add("TOTAL", "units", "TW", tot_units_tw, "sum(Units_TW)")
add("TOTAL", "units", "LW", tot_units_lw, "sum(Units_LW)")
add("TOTAL", "orders", "TW", tot_orders_tw, "sum(Orders_TW)")
add("TOTAL", "orders", "LW", tot_orders_lw, "sum(Orders_LW)")

if tot_rev_lw and not pd.isna(tot_rev_lw) and tot_rev_lw != 0:
    wow = (tot_rev_tw - tot_rev_lw) / tot_rev_lw * 100
    add("TOTAL", "revenue", "WoW", wow, "(sum(Revenue_TW) - sum(Revenue_LW)) / sum(Revenue_LW) * 100")

if tot_rev_ly and not pd.isna(tot_rev_ly) and tot_rev_ly != 0:
    yoy = (tot_rev_tw - tot_rev_ly) / tot_rev_ly * 100
    add("TOTAL", "revenue", "YoY", yoy, "(sum(Revenue_TW) - sum(Revenue_LY)) / sum(Revenue_LY) * 100")

# TOP entities by revenue TW
top_rev = df.dropna(subset=["Revenue_TW"]).sort_values("Revenue_TW", ascending=False).head(5)
for _, row in top_rev.iterrows():
    add(row["Entity"], "revenue", "TW", row["Revenue_TW"], "Revenue_TW value")
    if not pd.isna(row.get("Share_Pct", np.nan)):
        add(row["Entity"], "share", "TW", row["Share_Pct"], "Share_Pct value")
    if not pd.isna(row.get("Rank", np.nan)):
        add(row["Entity"], "rank", "TW", row["Rank"], "Rank value")

# Biggest WoW gainer and loser (using WoW_Pct column, skip NaN)
wow_valid = df.dropna(subset=["WoW_Pct"])
if not wow_valid.empty:
    gainer = wow_valid.loc[wow_valid["WoW_Pct"].idxmax()]
    loser = wow_valid.loc[wow_valid["WoW_Pct"].idxmin()]
    add(gainer["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", gainer["WoW_Pct"], "WoW_Pct value (top gainer)")
    add(loser["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", loser["WoW_Pct"], "WoW_Pct value (top loser)")

# Biggest YoY gainer and loser
yoy_valid = df.dropna(subset=["YoY_Pct"])
if not yoy_valid.empty:
    yg = yoy_valid.loc[yoy_valid["YoY_Pct"].idxmax()]
    yl = yoy_valid.loc[yoy_valid["YoY_Pct"].idxmin()]
    add(yg["Entity"], "revenue", "YoY", yg["YoY_Pct"], "YoY_Pct value (top gainer)")
    add(yl["Entity"], "revenue", "YoY", yl["YoY_Pct"], "YoY_Pct value (top loser)")

# Top entity by revenue LY
ly_valid = df.dropna(subset=["Revenue_LY"])
if not ly_valid.empty:
    top_ly = ly_valid.loc[ly_valid["Revenue_LY"].idxmax()]
    add(top_ly["Entity"], "revenue", "LY", top_ly["Revenue_LY"], "max(Revenue_LY)")

# Top entity by units TW
units_valid = df.dropna(subset=["Units_TW"])
if not units_valid.empty:
    top_units = units_valid.loc[units_valid["Units_TW"].idxmax()]
    add(top_units["Entity"], "units", "TW", top_units["Units_TW"], "max(Units_TW)")

# Top entity by orders TW
orders_valid = df.dropna(subset=["Orders_TW"])
if not orders_valid.empty:
    top_orders = orders_valid.loc[orders_valid["Orders_TW"].idxmax()]
    add(top_orders["Entity"], "orders", "TW", top_orders["Orders_TW"], "max(Orders_TW)")

# Limit to 25 facts
facts = facts[:25]

print(json.dumps(facts))
